There is an Item type, which has a name as a string, a price as a number, and a quantity as a number
class Item(name: str, price: int, quantity: int):
    this.name = name
    this.price = price
    this.quantity = quantity

Any item's total is its price times its quantity
$Item.total = $Item.price * $Item.quantity

Any order's subtotal is the sum of the totals of its items
$Order.subtotal = $Order.items.reduce(
    (total, item) => total + item.total,
    0
)

Any order's tax is 8% of its subtotal
$Order.tax = $Order.subtotal * 0.08

Any order's discount is initially 0
$Order.discount = 0

Any order's total is its subtotal plus tax minus discount
$Order.total = $Order.subtotal + $Order.tax - $Order.discount

Any order's item count is the sum of the quantities of its items
$Order.itemCount = $Order.items.reduce(
    (count, item) => count + item.quantity,
    0
)
